o1: Predicted to enable cysteine-type endopeptidase activity. Predicted to be involved in proteolysis involved in protein catabolic process. Is involved in defense response to bacterium. Predicted to be active in extracellular space and lysosome. Is expressed in intestine and in male. Used to study enterococcal infection. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in diabetes mellitus. Orthologous to human CTSB (cathepsin B).
